# mtncloud_power_schedule (Data Source)

Provides an MTN Cloud power schedule data source: looks up a schedule that powers instances on and off by name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_power_schedule" "example_power_schedule" {
  name = "TF Example power schedule"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the power schedule
- `name` (String) The name of the power schedule
